profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Kohl's Digital
profile.summary:
A zeal for programming combined with my passion for learning and work ethicality, drive my career
and its challenging roles.

Like many developers, scanf-printf & cin-cout plunged me into telling a weird
looking box my wishes and being amused as they came true. With every successful output I kept diving more into it. Soon my friendly box was moving objects
for me and calculating difficult multiplications. 

As I made my way through a 4 year Bachelor course,I went from tiny games to 3D model programming,BODMAS to algorithms and I also learnt the hardware genius inside my genie!  
My fondness for games and 3D objects stuck with me throughout this roller coaster ride called undergrad and I took up a job at a 3D simulation and game development start-up in Mumbai.

  A thrilling and rejuvenating experience, here at the startup, I witnessed how my code was helping others and I was loving it. It was me giving back to society in the micro-est way possible.   Soon I realized the need to expand my programming knowledge and here is what I did for the next 8-10
months?

Study>GRE>TOEFL>Applications>Anxiety>Accepted>Party>-pack-goodbye parents-friends-relatives-USA incoming.

  Fast forward a hectic student year and an unkempt beard and BOOM! I was selected for an
internship in Kohl’s Digital. I learnt some pretty cool stuff as an intern and managed to complete
all my given tasks and stood first in an intra-intern competition. (More details below!)  

To my delight, Kohl’s wanted me back as a full timer and I still had 6 months to graduation.

 I could have followed the crowd and given more interviews but instead I went ahead and founded my very own performing arts Startup - Tahelka.  
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfDK5Bj7R-5w_cU_0hlnqgw
https://www.facebook.com/tahelkaSJSU/  

I joined Kohl’s in January 2017 and since then I have been a part of a solid, fast-paced agile based team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
➢	Maintenance feature - Designed and developed APIs to support CRUD operations for all Kohl’s vendor attribute data. Interfaced soap api service calls accessing Kohl’s service provision layer to extract and use required catalog data.
➢	Search Feature – Utilized Kohl’s catalog data and built a multi-point search and maintenance feature for all the catalog data from existing Kohl’s server and databases.
➢	Data extraction and transfer - Generated SQL queries to fetch data combined from multiple tables from the existing Kohl’s exa-databases. Converted data using MyBatis framework and readied it for publish to internal Kohl’s MFT. 
Also leveraged Spring Batch to build a batch process to automate the data load Kohl’s Google Cloud storage for different environments.
➢	User management and setup - Leveraged OKTA Api create, update and delete users and control their access to the portal. Handled profile management, allocation and maintenance for users and their profile changes based on requirements from the users and the client.
➢	Release management – Supported release from data sanity point of view. Handled data flow verification and data correctness prior to and during an ongoing release. Performed splunk logs analysis to keep track of system dynamics amidst release.

volunteerExperiences.role: Conducted a workshop on basic game programming using Unity3d game engine and C#
volunteerExperiences.companyName: Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering
volunteerExperiences.description:
My collegue and I conducted a workshop on Game Programming with Unity3D game engine using the C# programming language. This workshop was associated with the IEEE student chapter.
The games built by participants were targeted for the desktop and Android Platform.
The following were the topics covered,
- Unity3D game engine interface basics,
- Game physics basics,
- asset integration,
- Animation integration,
- audio Integration,
- programming with MonoDevelop,
- porting to Android,
- Android touch basics.

volunteerExperiences.role: Conducted a workshop on basic animation and object modelling using the animation tool Blender3D.
volunteerExperiences.companyName: Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering
volunteerExperiences.description:
I conducted 2 workshops on animation using the Blender3D animation tool.
The workshops were associated with the CSI and ACM student chapter of my college.
Topics taught: 
- Animation tool and user interface basics,
- Object modelling basics,
- animation basics.
The workshop ended with the participants having gained the basic knowledge of creating animations and simple objects in Blender3D.

projects.title: Android MyTube application
projects.description:
An android application which allows the user to search YouTube videos by text.
The user can play the videos in full screen mode.
User can also save videos to a playlist and play them repeatedly without having to search them again.
Login feature provided through Google Sign-In.

projects.title: UML Parser using JAVA BYTECODE
projects.description:
This project delivers a UML diagram representation based on any input java code file.
A visual representation of classes, methods, attributes, extended classes, implemented interfaces, associations and dependencies is produced after parsing through a java file.

organizations.name: Tahelka Performing Arts Group
organizations.description:
youtube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfDK5Bj7R-5w_cU_0hlnqgw
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/tahelka_set_stage_on_fire/

Our life and its experiences are a direct result of our interactions with society. People and situations around us mould us into the individual that we are today. I founded Tahelka - Performing Arts Group with the sole purpose of giving back to this very society - through entertainment. 

Our talented team, of over 40 performers, has multi-cultural dancers, singers and actors. Since the last 2 years we have been entertaining crowds all over San Francisco Bay Area with our mesmerizing performances. We indulge in event based choreographies, wedding choreographies and thematic skits. 

Our singing team filled with vocalists and musicians leaves audiences enchanted with their combined talent at social events.

All our efforts are directed towards bringing smiles to people and making them forget their worldly problems, at least for the duration of our performance.
